in_sanskrit.name: वीरस
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: वीर (Vīra) means hero, brave, valiant. स (Sa) is a suffix that can denote 'son of'. So, Birsa could be interpreted as 'son of the hero' or 'heroic son'.

in_hindi.name: वीरसा
in_hindi.long_meaning: वीर (Vīra) means hero, brave, valiant. सा (Sā) is a suffix that can denote 'sa' or 'as'. So, Birsa could be interpreted as 'heroic', 'brave as', or 'son of the hero'.

in_tamil.name: வீரச
in_tamil.long_meaning: வீர் (Vīṟ) means valiant, brave, heroic. So, Birsa could be interpreted as 'valiant one' or 'brave one'.

in_telugu.name: బీరశ
in_telugu.long_meaning: బీర (Bīra) means brave, valiant, heroic. శ (śa) is a suffix that can denote 'son of'. So, Birsa could be interpreted as 'son of the brave one' or 'brave son'.

in_marathi.name: Birsa
in_marathi.long_meaning: Birsa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Birsa is derived from the Sanskrit word 'bhrāmaras' which means 'strong, powerful or fierce'. In Hindu mythology, it is the name of various deities and heroes known for their bravery and strength.
